questions.q: We just lost the ball. Drag the left midfielder to where they recover first.
options: Stay out wide on the left
The space in front of our goal
questions.explain: Right. Recovering in front of our goal puts you back between the ball and the goal.
choiceExplanations: Chasing from behind rarely catches the ball, and our goal stays open.
Staying wide leaves the middle open, so the ball carrier runs straight at goal.
Right. Recovering in front of our goal puts you back between the ball and the goal.

questions.q: Put the steps after losing the ball in order, from first to last.
options: Recover toward the space in front of goal
questions.explain: Yes. We lose it, recover, get cover ready, and only then step toward the ball.
choiceExplanations: Yes. We lose it, recover, get cover ready, and only then step toward the ball.
We only need to recover after the ball is lost.
Cover is ready once a teammate has recovered behind.
We approach last, because cover must be ready behind first.

questions.q: Now the right midfielder is caught upfield. Tap where they should recover.
options: Back in front of our goal
Stay out wide on the right
questions.explain: Yes. Just like on the left, recover toward our goal to rebuild protection first.
choiceExplanations: Chasing from behind rarely catches the ball, and it leaves our goal less protected.
Yes. Just like on the left, recover toward our goal to rebuild protection first.
Out wide is away from the danger, so the middle stays open.
